sequence_points.name: Abstract Cityscape with Vertical Forms
sequence_points.description: A vertically oriented abstract painting featuring blurred, upright forms in warm earth tones and muted reds, suggesting a city skyline. The artwork is mounted on a wall, partially cropped at the edges, with soft brushwork and indistinct details.

sequence_points.name: Abstract Vertical Composition
sequence_points.description: A vertically oriented abstract painting featuring blurred, vertical streaks of muted earth tones and grays, mounted on a wall with a white, curved architectural element in the foreground.

sequence_points.name: Landscape with Sunset and Water
sequence_points.description: A vertical painting depicting a serene sunset over a body of water, with warm hues of orange and pink blending into a dusky blue sky. The horizon line is centered, and the reflection of the sky is visible on the calm water surface.

sequence_points.name: Landscape with River and Trees
sequence_points.description: A landscape painting depicting a river winding through a forested area, with muted earth tones and soft lighting. The artwork is mounted on a museum wall with a dark frame.
